title: 第7章 天魔教使者照杀不误第8章 阴阳学宫来人
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
面对飞射而来的剑气，楚云露出不屑之色。
手臂抬起，一柄掉落在地的剑，瞬间朝着他飞射而来，最后被他握在手中。
“你这天罡剑法，只有其形，没有其神，让我来给你演示一下，天罡剑法真正的威力！”
随着这话响起，楚云快速挥舞手中长剑。
咻咻咻！
只见一道道剑气飞射而出，发出恐怖的破空声，看其威力，比太玄宗主施展的强十倍不止。
见到这一幕，太玄宗主瞬间停止手中动作，瞪大眼睛。
“天罡剑法，注重剑道参悟，亏你修炼三年，居然还没有领悟剑法精髓，真是可悲！”
“怎么可能？”
太玄宗主站在原地，目光呆滞。
他自认天罡剑法是他最强武技，没有人比他更懂天罡剑法。
可是现在，楚云施展出来的天罡剑法，比他的强十倍不止，这让他难以接受。
“现在你知道谁才是废物了吧？”
在太玄宗主吃惊的目光中，楚云突然纵身跃起，与剑合二为一，朝着太玄宗主飞射而来。
“人剑合一？”
见到这一幕，不仅太玄宗主吃惊，就连站在他旁边的黑袍老者，也是目光一凝。
“人剑合一，此子不过十五岁，居然领悟到这个境界，当真是妖孽。”
长剑快如闪电，不等太玄宗主反应过来，便从他身体中穿过。
噗！
与此同时，太玄宗主神情一变，张口喷出一口鲜血。

而在他身后不远处，长剑落地，显出楚云的身形。
太玄宗主此时才恢复过来。
当下单膝跪地，眼中露出不甘之色。
“天罡剑法，我前后修炼了数十年，到现在都没有达到人剑合一境界，没想到最后见到，居然是在别人手里。”
太玄宗主嘴角勾起一抹自嘲。
楚云缓缓转过身，看着太玄宗主道：“你只修炼其形，不参悟剑道，就算你再修炼一百年，也是徒劳！”
“参悟剑道？”
太玄宗主笑了。
这些年，他只顾修炼剑法招式，却没有认真去参悟剑道，去参悟属于他的剑道，这才导致他无法达到人剑合一的境界。
只可惜，他知道的太晚了。
缓缓闭上眼睛，太玄宗主彻底死去。
“不错，年纪轻轻就领悟出人剑合一，假以时日，定能成为天武境强者。”
见到太玄宗主被杀死，黑袍老者不但没有出手相助，反而一脸兴奋。
因为他发现了一个武道天才，或者说武道妖孽。
楚云缓缓转头，看着眼前陌生的黑袍老者，问道：“你是何人？”
他在太玄宗呆了三年，几乎所有太玄宗长老都认识。
但是眼前这人似乎没有见过。
黑袍老者一脸高傲，笑道：“自我介绍，我是天魔教使者，此次来太玄宗，主要是想招降太玄宗主替我们天魔教做事。”
“但是他现在已经被你杀死，不如你加入我们天魔教，我不但可以许诺你做太玄宗新宗主，还会向教主请示，帮助你冲击天武境，如何？”
天魔教，青州第一邪派，是整个武道正派的公敌。

听说在中州，北州和南州都有分部，至于总部在哪里没人知道。
传言天魔教教主的修为，已经达到惊人的武皇境。
“让我加入天魔教，岂不是让我与整个武道正派为敌，你觉得我会答应吗？”
此话一出，黑袍老者脸上的笑容瞬间消失。
content_en:
Facing the flying sword energy, Chu Yun showed disdain.
He raised his arm, and a sword that fell to the ground flew towards him in an instant, and was finally held in his hand.
"Your Tiangang Sword Technique only has its form, but no spirit. Let me show you the true power of Tiangang Sword Technique!"
As these words rang out, Chu Yun quickly waved the long sword in his hand.
Whoosh!
I saw sword energy flying out one after another, making a terrifying sound of breaking through the air. Judging from its power, it was more than ten times more powerful than what Taixuan Sect Master had used.
Seeing this scene, Master Taixuan immediately stopped his movements and stared wide-eyed.
"Tiangang Sword Technique focuses on the understanding of the sword. You have been practicing for three years, but you still haven't understood the essence of the sword technique. It's really sad!"
"How is that possible?"
Taixuan Sect Master stood there, his eyes dull.
He considers Tiangang Sword Technique to be his strongest martial art, and no one knows Tiangang Sword Technique better than him.
But now, the Tiangang Sword Technique displayed by Chu Yun was more than ten times stronger than his, which was hard for him to accept.
"Now you know who the loser is, right?"
Under the surprised gaze of the Taixuan Sect Master, Chu Yun suddenly jumped up, merged with the sword, and flew towards the Taixuan Sect Master.
"Man and sword unite?"
Seeing this scene, not only Master Taixuan was surprised, but even the old man in black robe standing next to him had his eyes fixed.
"Man and sword merge into one. This boy is only fifteen years old, but he has realized this realm. He is truly a monster."
The long sword was as fast as lightning and passed through the body of Taixuan Sect Master before he could react.
puff!
At the same time, Master Taixuan's expression changed, and he opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of blood.
Not far behind him, the long sword fell to the ground, revealing Chu Yun's figure.
Only then did Master Taixuan recover.
He knelt down on one knee, with a look of reluctance in his eyes.
"I have been practicing the Tiangang Sword Technique for decades, but I have not yet reached the point where the sword and man are united. I never expected that the last time I saw it, it would be in the hands of someone else."
The corner of Taixuan Sect Leader's mouth curled up with a hint of self-mockery.
Chu Yun slowly turned around, looked at Taixuan Sect Master and said, "If you only practice the form and don't understand the sword, even if you practice for another hundred years, it will be in vain!"
"Understand the art of swordsmanship?"
Master Taixuan smiled.
Over the years, he only focused on practicing swordsmanship, but did not seriously understand the way of swordsmanship and his own way of swordsmanship. This led to his inability to reach the realm of the unity of man and sword.
Unfortunately, he knew it too late.
Slowly closing his eyes, Master Taixuan died completely.
"Yes, at a young age, I have realized that man and sword are one. Given time, I will definitely become a strong man in the Tianwu Realm."
Seeing that the Taixuan Sect Master was killed, the old man in black robe not only did not help, but he looked excited.
Because he discovered a martial arts genius, or martial arts monster.
Chu Yun slowly turned his head, looked at the unfamiliar old man in black robe in front of him, and asked, "Who are you?"
He stayed in Taixuanzong for three years and knew almost all the elders of Taixuanzong.
But it seems that the person in front of me has never been seen before.
The black-robed old man looked arrogant and said with a smile: "Introduce myself, I am the messenger of the Heavenly Demon Sect. This time I came to Taixuan Sect mainly to recruit the leader of the Taixuan Sect to work for our Heavenly Demon Sect."
"But he has been killed by you now. Why don't you join our Heavenly Demon Sect? Not only can I promise you to be the new leader of Taixuan Sect, but I will also ask the leader for instructions and help you attack the Heavenly Martial Realm. How about that?"
The Heavenly Demon Sect, the number one evil sect in Qingzhou, is the public enemy of the entire martial arts sect.
I heard that there are branches in Zhongzhou, Beizhou and Nanzhou, but no one knows where the headquarters is.
It is rumored that the cultivation level of the leader of the Demon Sect has reached the astonishing level of the Martial Emperor.
"If you ask me to join the Demon Sect, wouldn't it make me an enemy of the entire martial arts sect? Do you think I will agree?"
As soon as these words came out, the smile on the black-robed old man's face disappeared instantly.
